lines.t: Receive it.
Let it settle.
Know His love.
Breathe Him in.
Breathe Him in, let the Word sink in,
Not a quick quote—take it all in.
Know His love, know who He is,
Let the song of the Lamb live within.
Breathe Him in, let the Word sink in,
Take it to heart, let it…
More than a phrase at the tip of the tongue,
Know His love—let the meaning come.
Take it in. (Receive.)
Let it sit. (Go deep.)
Know His love.
More than a beat.
Take it in. (Receive.)
Let it sit. (Go deep.)
Song of the Lamb—
Let it repeat.
Words on a page, don't skim past the meal,
Slow that pace, get to what's real.
Not just a line for a clever reply,
Stay with the meaning, give it some time.
A plate can be full while a seat stays vacant,
Food right there, but nobody takes it.
Partake of His words, receive what is given,
Know who He is, not somebody's revision.
Love isn't small enough to fit in a slogan,
More to receive when the heart stays open.
Not for applause, not a badge to display,
Something to carry beyond what is said.
Don't rush the meaning.
Don't miss the meal.
Know who He is.
Know love that's real.

Not a quick quote—take it all in.
Know His love, know who He is,
Let the song of the Lamb live within.
Breathe Him in, let the Word sink in,
Take it to heart, let it settle again.
More than a phrase at the tip of the tongue,
Know His love—let the meaning come.
Take it in. (Receive.)
Let it sit. (Go deep.)
Know His love.
More than a beat.
Bread on the table, room to partake,
More than a sample, more than a taste.
Revelation—knowing Him truly,
Not a familiar expression used loosely.
Every sentence deserves attention,
Who He is—not a human invention.
Knowledge of love, let it reach beneath
Everything learned just to sound complete.
Let the song of the Lamb find a place to remain,
Not one listen, then filed away.
Receive His words till their meaning takes hold,
There's more to His love than a phrase can hold.
Not just quoted.
Not just heard.
Taken to heart—
Receive His words.
More than repetition.
Deeper recognition.
Who He truly is—
Let it settle within.
